question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"until."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Until"** is used to indicate the time before which an action or event will not happen. (निर्दिष्ट समय या घटना के होने तक)
 
• It is often used with negative constructions.
 
 
• **Example**: *"I won't leave **until**__ you come back."*
 
 
 
• **"Until"** can also be used with a specific time.
 __
 
• **Example**: *"I'll be here **until__** 5 pm."*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
 
• Correct passage:

The figure of Arthur first appeared in Welsh poetry in the __late__ sixth and early seventh centuries, a hero who was __said to__ lead the Britons in battle against Saxon invaders. But it wasn’t __until__ the 12th century that he was first tied to this dramatic headland, known as Tintagel.

The timeless popularity of the Arthur legend has overshadowed a central, unresolved ______ (4) ______: Was there really a King Arthur, or at least a historical prototype upon whom Geoffrey's hero is ______ (5) ______? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"None" **means not any, not one (of a group of three or more)(कोई भी नहीं, एक भी नहीं (तीन या अधिक समूह में से)) and cannot be used to fill the blank as it does not make sense in the context of the sentence.
 
• **"Beyond"** suggests going further than a certain point, which is not relevant to the sentence. (की दूसरी ओर, के परे)
 
• **"Unless"** suggests a condition that must be met for an action or event to happen, which does not fit the sentence structure. (यदि... नहीं; तब तक नहीं जब तक)

45:Tf9a,

The correct answer is **"question."**
